data.narrative:
Planted Solar is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $32M to date. The valuation landscape for early-stage frontier tech in this sector is sparse: while 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA) operate in Climate & Energy, none share sufficiently similar stage and scale characteristics to support a traditional peer-multiple analysis. A narrow peer set—requiring at least three datapoints at the same or adjacent stage—could not be constructed, making median comparables unreliable.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised as a proxy for Series A valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $64M. This method directly anchors to Planted Solar's observable financing history rather than speculative peer multiples.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $54M–$74M, centered on $64M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the median, acknowledging execution risk and the absence of tight comparables. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the 2.0x multiplier to this specific subsector, near-term capital deployment efficiency, and competitive positioning relative to the identified peer set (Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Enovix). Additional transaction data from Climate & Energy Series A rounds would meaningfully sharpen this valuation.
